data.description:
Mirror inventory finding F3 (reports/stability/mirror-inventory.md), HIGH, comments already drifted.

Two complementary sets, six sites, nothing enforcing that they partition TicketType:
- exempt ("bug","session_log","code_review","identity"): _commands/gates.py:45,
  _commands/composer.py:47, llm/plan_review/orchestrator.py:560
- complement ("task","story","epic"): llm/plan_review/claimability.py:38,
  _commands/transition_close.py:46, _commands/gates.py:215

False single-sourcing claims: gates.py:42-44 says "Single-sourced here so ... cannot drift";
composer.py:42-46 admits "Kept in lockstep with"; claimability.py:40-41 prose names 2 of the 4
exempt types. Only test: assert "bug" in ... (test_bug_blast_radius_escalation_ad0d.py:199).

Consequence: an eighth ticket type lands in neither set — neither gated nor exempted. This decides
whether the plan-review claim gate runs at all.

Proposed fix: add-parity-check — assert set(get_args(TicketType)) == exempt | reviewed, with all six
sites referencing one constant.
data.title: Plan-review ticket-type exemption is split across six sites with no enforcement (mirror F3)
